question: Quantos filmes existem associados a cada gênero?
sql_attempts: SELECT g.nome_genero, COUNT(DISTINCT b.sk_movie_id) AS total_filmes FROM dim_genres AS g JOIN bridge_movie_genre AS b ON b.sk_genre_id = g.sk_genre_id JOIN dim_movies AS m ON m.sk_movie_id = b.sk_movie_id GROUP BY g.sk_genre_id, g.nome_genero ORDER BY total_filmes DESC, g.nome_genero LIMIT 100

question: Qual produtora acumulou o maior lucro total em BRL?
sql_attempts: WITH producer_stats AS (SELECT dim_companies.sk_company_id, dim_companies.nome_produtora, COUNT(*) AS filmes_elegiveis, SUM(fact_movies_performance.receita_brl - fact_movies_performance.orcamento_brl) AS lucro_total_brl FROM bridge_movie_company JOIN dim_companies ON bridge_movie_company.sk_company_id = dim_companies.sk_company_id JOIN dim_movies ON bridge_movie_company.sk_movie_id = dim_movies.sk_movie_id JOIN fact_movies_performance ON dim_movies.sk_movie_id = fact_movies_performance.sk_movie_id WHERE NOT fact_movies_performance.receita_brl IS NULL AND NOT fact_movies_performance.orcamento_brl IS NULL GROUP BY dim_companies.sk_company_id, dim_companies.nome_produtora) SELECT sk_company_id, nome_produtora, filmes_elegiveis, lucro_total_brl FROM producer_stats WHERE lucro_total_brl = (SELECT MAX(lucro_total_brl) FROM producer_stats) LIMIT 100

question: Quais filmes têm a maior quantidade de avaliações de usuários?
sql_attempts: SELECT m.sk_movie_id, m.titulo, r.qtd_avaliacoes_usuarios FROM dim_movies AS m JOIN dim_reviews AS r ON m.sk_movie_id = r.sk_movie_id WHERE NOT r.qtd_avaliacoes_usuarios IS NULL AND r.qtd_avaliacoes_usuarios = (SELECT MAX(qtd_avaliacoes_usuarios) FROM dim_reviews) LIMIT 100

question: Qual filme tem a maior divergência entre a média dos usuários e a nota IMDb?
sql_attempts: WITH base AS (SELECT m.sk_movie_id, m.titulo, r.nota_media_usuarios, f.nota_imdb, r.qtd_avaliacoes_usuarios, f.qtd_imdb, ABS(r.nota_media_usuarios - f.nota_imdb) AS divergencia FROM dim_movies AS m JOIN fact_movies_performance AS f ON m.sk_movie_id = f.sk_movie_id JOIN dim_reviews AS r ON m.sk_movie_id = r.sk_movie_id WHERE r.qtd_avaliacoes_usuarios > 0 AND f.qtd_imdb > 0) SELECT sk_movie_id, titulo, nota_media_usuarios, nota_imdb, qtd_avaliacoes_usuarios, qtd_imdb, divergencia FROM base WHERE divergencia = (SELECT MAX(divergencia) FROM base) LIMIT 100
